assault.name: Assault
assault.description: +2 combat total. If you lose, suffer 1 additional damage.

guard.name: Guard
guard.description: +1 combat total. On a loss, reduce incoming damage by 1, minimum 1.

counter.name: Counter
counter.description: +3 against Assault, otherwise -1. Win while defending against Assault to retaliate for 1 damage.

trick.name: Trick
trick.description: Pay 1 Fate. +2 against Guard or Counter. A win suppresses their reduction or retaliation.
